Note: THE CRITERION IS IMPEDANCE, NOT CHEMISTRY (10.08.2026.): ESR at 100 kHz <= 0,15 Ω and rated ripple current >= 0,35 A rms. They carry 0,88 A pp on 3,3 V and 1,07 A pp on 5 V, so 0,15 Ω keeps the ripple at 132 and 161 mV. A polymer part meets it (20 to 50 mΩ), as does an electrolytic marked low ESR or low impedance, but NOT a plain electrolytic (about 1 Ω gives 878 mV and pushes the ESP32-S3 and the flash out of specification).
